punchline: After a crash at 19, Brendon Burchard was left with three questions: Did I live? Did I love? Did I matter?
thirty_sec: At 19, Brendon Burchard survived a serious car accident in the Dominican Republic. Afterwards, three questions stayed with him: Did I live? Did I love? Did I matter? They shaped his career as a coach and author. In High Performance Habits, he identifies six learnable habits of long-term high performers: seek clarity, generate energy, raise necessity, increase productivity, develop influence and demonstrate courage.
question: How would you honestly answer: did I live, did I love, did I matter?
